stem_match: NFKC/casefolded full word and math-operator tokens against all EmbedLLM raw full prompts and extracted stems

data_split.rule: half support per benchmark by source group, remainder query

performance_scope: 20 official lightweight candidates, external release and model IDs; family overlap allowed
checkpoint_selection_source: existing EmbedLLM validation; no external fine-tuning or selection
unknown_benchmark_offset: frozen learned difficulty head plus unweighted mean of all five trained benchmark biases
probe_selection: shared per seed, nested balanced random within support pool

reference_policy.rule: largest equal quota after removing all seed probe prefixes; text only

fixed_policy: same-budget best observed benchmark-macro accuracy, ties first official model

interval.unit: paired queries within benchmarks after seed averaging; conditional on fixed roster, support and checkpoints

generation: Recorded correctness only; no API calls or inference cost estimates.
